name: NG exhaustion focused POX trade strategy proposal
baseline_management_from_finalized_phase: Execute only from a validated causal setup.
Preserve the normal +60 parent management boundary unless a new additive rule independently validates.
After parent exit, reset state rather than automatically inheriting old POX ancestry.
Re-enter only from a later trusted causal setup; realized delayed recovery alone is not a signal.

stage_1_initial_continuation.objective: Find the earliest causal POX entry checkpoint with positive and stable raw-tape economics on the fixed 3,429 population.

stage_2_branch_prediction.objective: Predict authoritative future FLIP versus SAME from causal prefixes without backdating future branch information.

stage_3_branch_management.objective: Only if stage-2 prediction is stable enough to matter, compare hold/exit/reset/reverse/follow-new-state actions at their actual causal timestamps.

stage_4_delayed_same_watch.objective: Research delayed/re-expression after the original management boundary as a separate watch/re-entry setup without rewriting the original trade.

negative_evidence.finding: Generic D1 +0 early entry failed its tune profitability gate and was effectively flat gross in the confirmation block before costs.
negative_evidence.implication: No generic immediate-entry rule transfers into POX. POX initial-continuation economics must validate independently on its own fixed population.

required_before_any_freeze: Authoritative fixed 3,429 ledger loaded and validated without population reconstruction.
Exact causal signal timestamp defined for every executable case or marked unavailable without deleting the row.
Raw-tape first-fill economics reported at +5/+10/+20/+30/+60 with 0.5/1/2 tick cost stress.
Chronological OOT stability reported, including losing and choppy rows.
FLIP/SAME branch predictor independently validated if it is to alter management.
Successor/reset/re-entry actions independently validated at actual causal timestamps.
do_not_trade: Do not trade from the 94.4% descriptive persistence number alone.
Do not infer fixed-population membership from canonical P/O/X adjacency.
Do not use realized FLIP/SAME before it is causally knowable.
Do not reverse automatically because a successor appears.
Do not re-enter automatically because a SAME case later recovers.
Do not use D0-D5 independent outcomes to tune this strategy before the POX standalone freeze.
